ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 35% high-intensity (white) stippling against 65% low-intensity (black) base across visible ventral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, high-frequency white mottling and small irregular blobs (1-10 pixel diameter) distributed uniformly across the black ventral surface; localized cluster of larger high-intensity spots at the lower central junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the central lobe convergence; approximate 45-degree interior pixel angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes vary from 3 to 15 pixels; prominent jagged protrusion on the inner-right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the entire visible surface, consistent with high-density scarring or colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive hook-like protrusion on the distal tip of the right lobe (viewer perspective); significant irregular excision/notch on the upper-left trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'galaxy' pattern characterized by exceptionally dense, fine-grained white stippling across the total visible surface area.
